observations: Conservative margin retains board housings and connectors in all reviewed normal examples; both 180 orientations retained. Crop boxes occupy57.2–65.7% of source image. This is category-specific blue segmentation, not a general PCB detector. No pose registration or landmark error claim. All original source pixels remain in evaluation denominator; annotation exclusions reported after evaluation.
remaining_risks: Unreviewed normals may have geometry faults despite no segmentation fallback
Blue-color rule may react to anomalous color changes
Letterbox changes appearance/receptive field relative to original direct-square resize
Crop margins preserve connectors in sample but do not prove universal containment
selection_basis: Systematic fit/calibration IDs and min/max crop-area normals, no anomaly evidence
